newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Zhejiang Express seen in HK$3.4 bln float - source.
newsitem.headline: Zhejiang Express seen in HK$3.4 bln float - source.

text.p: Zhejiang Expressway, a toll road operator in China's eastern province of Zhejiang, is expected to raise about HK$3.4 billion through an H-share listing in Hong Kong in May, market sources said on Thursday.
Sources said the company is expected to issue 1.5 billion H-shares at about HK$2.30 per share, putting the issue price at about a 15 to 20 percent discount to net asset value (NAV).
About 90 percent of the issue is expected to be placed internationally, with the remaining 10 percent to be offered to the public in Hong Kong, sources said.
Zhejiang Expressway holds four highway projects in Zhejiang province including Hangyong Expressway, sources said.
Proceeds are expected to be used to fund construction of two of its projects and for acquisition of other highway projects within the province, they said.
Sources said BZW is expected to be the sponsor of the issue.
Zhejiang Expressway is expected to hold a presentation for analysts on Monday, they said.
